title: Cafe Franchise Opportunity
name: Maa Ki Chai, 50 Franchisees, Est'd in 2024, Pune HQ
description: Maa Ki Chai is an Indian tea and café brand offering a low-investment, zero-royalty franchise model designed for entrepreneurs looking to start a simple and scalable food and beverage business. The brand currently has 50+ cafes and partners, with expansion focused on Tier-2, Tier-3 cities and selected metro locations. The business operates through a chef-less and standardized model, allowing outlets to be run with relatively simple operations and limited space requirements. The compact kiosk format is designed for outlets of approximately 100 sq. ft. , while campus and institutional café formats are also available. Franchisees receive one-day training, outlet setup guidance, branding support, launch assistance and ongoing operational support. The menu includes Maa Ki Chai's signature chai, jaggery chai premix, instant masala chai premix, Maggi, idli, cold coffee and hot coffee. Standardized recipes, menu and operating processes help maintain consistency across outlets. The brand is GST and FSSAI registered. Maa Ki Chai's key differentiation is its low-investment, zero-royalty and chef-less franchise model, combined with a compact outlet format and standardized operating system. The model is suitable for locations with regular walk-in demand such as markets, educational areas, offices and institutional campuses. Franchisees can benefit from an established brand format, training, setup and launch support, along with ongoing operational assistance.
